title: Set your username
lead: You're almost done creating your account. Choose the username you'll use on the site to finish signing up.
usernameHintChars: 2 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and _
usernameHintEdges: Start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a number
cannotChange: You can't change your username later
displayNameCanChange: You can change your display name later
appPublicNotice: Your username and Challenge results are shown on the web leaderboard. If you don't want to appear there, turn on "Hide me from the leaderboard" in Settings after signing up. Your public profile on the web (your username's page) stays even if you leave the leaderboard.

validation.tooShort: Use at least 2 characters for your username
validation.tooLong: Use 20 characters or fewer for your username
validation.invalidFormat: Start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores
validation.prohibited: This username contains words that are not allowed.
validation.alreadySet: Your username has already been set
validation.displayNameTooLong: Use 50 characters or fewer for your display name
validation.displayNameProhibited: Your display name contains words that are not allowed.
validation.error: Something went wrong. Please try again
validation.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a while and try again.
validation.banned: Your account has been suspended, so you can't do this.
validation.unauthorized: You have been logged out. Please log in again
